Okay, listen up, everyone. There is a lot of gossip about the trials, so here are the facts. The trials are next Saturday, not this Saturday. Next Saturday, at our home beach, at seven. The coach is Dana Reid. She works with the state team, and she picks the interschool squad. Not me. I just surf, like you. The squad has four surfers and one reserve. Everybody gets two heats of twenty minutes, and she watches all of them. Some of you asked me if you need a new board. No. Surf your normal board. And one more thing: I will announce the names on Monday, on the club group, not before. So please, stop asking me. I don't know. Nobody knows. Just surf well.

Hey, Renato, it's Millie. So, your mum called our house last night because your phone was off. Mum talked to her for like an hour. Your mum said she was really proud of you. She told Mum that you trained every day in Brazil and that you never missed a comp. She also said you were nervous before big heats, and that you always ate a banana before you paddled out. Mum laughed so much. Oh, and Mum said she could drive you to the trials on Saturday, and she told me she wanted to stay and watch. So, sorry, you have a fan on the beach. Also, Dad said he would make pancakes for you before the trials. Okay, that's all the news. Call your mum!
